role.gk.desc: Stays on his line and plays it short.
role.sweeperKeeper.desc: Supports a high line and looks for the forward pass straight away.
role.ballPlayingDef.desc: Steps up a few yards and looks for passes forward.
role.stopper.desc: Steps out aggressively onto the striker: presses more, tires a bit more.
role.fb.desc: Gets forward sensibly and gets back to defend.
role.wingBack.desc: In possession he becomes a winger and crosses a lot. Covers plenty of ground: tires sooner.
role.invertedFB.desc: Tucks inside and helps the build-up.
role.anchor.desc: Sits in front of the defence and screens it.
role.regista.desc: Sets the tempo from deep and looks for the forward pass.
role.ballWinner.desc: Presses and wins the ball back; keeps it simple.
role.cm.desc: Links the lines and gets forward when he can.
role.mezzala.desc: Drifts into the half-space and attacks the box.
role.boxToBox.desc: Covers every blade of grass, presses and gets forward. Tires sooner.
role.playmaker.desc: Stays at the heart of the play, spreading passes forward.
role.wideMid.desc: Covers the flank in both phases.
role.winger.desc: Pushes high up the flank, takes on his man and crosses.
role.defWinger.desc: Works hard in cover and presses the opposing full-back.
role.wideForward.desc: Attacks the flanks in a front three.
role.insideForward.desc: Cuts inside to shoot, crosses little.
role.am.desc: Between the lines, creates and gets into the box.
role.shadowStriker.desc: Makes runs behind the striker to finish.
role.enganche.desc: Pure quality: creates but defends little.
role.advancedForward.desc: Attacks the space in behind and the box.
role.targetMan.desc: Focal point for crosses and high balls.
role.falseNine.desc: Drops between the lines to link play and create space.
role.poacher.desc: Lives in the box to finish chances; presses little.
live.shoutHint.encourage: Helps players whose morale is low
live.shoutHint.demand: Spurs on the professionals, weighs on those who handle pressure badly
live.quickHint: Changes apply straight away. With the tactical pause you stop the clock to think.
live.noSubs: No subs left or empty bench.
live.pauseHint: Changes apply straight away and stay after the match too.
live.ppdaHint: PPDA: passes we allow the opponents for each ball we win back. The lower it is, the higher we press.
an.redUs: We're down to ten: shorten the distances, drop the line and give up a striker.
an.redThem: They're down to ten: stretch the play and raise the tempo, the space is there.
an.twoBooked: We have {n} players on a yellow: one flash of temper and we're down to ten. Consider a precautionary sub.
an.bookedRisk: {name} is on a yellow and playing it hard: either take him off or ease off his pressing.
an.tiredKey: {name} is at {v} fitness: from here on he loses his duels. Get a sub ready.
an.tiredMany: {n} players are running on empty: without subs in the last half-hour the team will fall apart.
an.noSubsLate: You still have almost all your subs: fresh legs are worth more now than at 90'.
an.justConceded: We've just conceded: this is when you let in the second. Ten minutes of discipline, then go again.
an.justScored: We've scored: they'll push forward, be ready to break on the counter.
an.twoDownLate: Two down late on: we need real risks — attacking mentality and an extra striker.
an.twoUpLate: Two goals to the good: manage it, slow the tempo and rest the players one booking from a ban.
an.trailLate: One down late on: push the line up and look for width, but cover the counter.
an.leadLate: One up: the last minutes are won by staying compact, not by everyone dropping back.
an.drawLate: Finely balanced: whoever raises the tempo first usually decides it.
an.trailEarly: Behind, but there's plenty of time: don't change everything, just play more directly.
an.leadEarly: Ahead early: don't sit back, it's the classic mistake. Keep playing the same way.
an.xgHighNoGoals: {xg} xG and no goals: the chances are coming, the finishing isn't. Keep the same approach.
an.xgLowManyShots: {n} shots for only {xg} xG: we're shooting from too far out. Let's try to get into the box.
an.xgAHigh: The opponents already have {xg} xG: we're giving away real chances, we need more cover.
an.luckyLead: We're ahead but the xG says {xg} to {xga}: we're living dangerously. Better tighten up.
an.unluckyTrail: {xg} xG to {xga} and we're behind: the performance is there, don't change everything.
an.xgBalanced: An even game in the numbers too: one incident or a move from the bench will decide it.
an.fewShots: Only {n} shots: the play stops before the box. Try playing more directly.
an.manyShots: {n} shots: we're laying siege. Keep it up, sooner or later one goes in.
an.lowOnTarget: Very few shots on target: we're picking the wrong moment to shoot.
an.longShots: Only {v}% of our shots come from inside the box: too many from distance, we need more runs into the area.
an.boxShotsGood: Almost every shot comes from inside the box: exactly what we want.
an.oppShotsMany: They already have {n} shots: we're under pressure, drop the line a little or add a holding midfielder.
an.possHighNoShots: {v}% possession and just {n} shots: sterile passing. Look for width and crosses.
an.possLow: {v}% possession: they're dictating the pace. Press higher or slow the tempo.
an.possLowButDanger: We don't have much of the ball but we're more dangerous: the counter-attacks are working.
an.accLow: Pass accuracy at {v}%: too many mistakes. Play it shorter and slow the tempo.
an.accHigh: Passing at {v}%: the ball is moving, their pressing isn't touching us.
an.fewPasses: Few passes: we're playing it too long and giving the ball away.
an.ppdaGood: PPDA {v}: the pressing is working, we're winning the ball high up.
an.ppdaBad: PPDA {v}: we're not pressing. Either press earlier or accept sitting deep and countering.
an.oppPressHigh: They're pressing us hard (PPDA {v}) and we're failing to play out: go more direct to skip the press.
an.weRecoverHigh: {n} balls won back: the defensive work is paying off.
an.weLoseDuels: They've won back {n} balls: we're losing the midfield battles.
an.duelLoser: {name} has lost {n} duels: they're targeting him there, give him help or change him.
an.crossesMany: {n} crosses and little to show: we don't have the size to win it in the box. Try keeping it low.
an.crossesNone: We never cross: with the wide men high up we can attack the box that way too.
an.offsidesMany: {n} offsides: we're timing our runs in behind badly, wait half a second.
an.oppOffsides: We've caught them offside {n} times: the defensive line is stepping up well.
an.cornersMany: {n} corners: we can hurt them from set pieces, send the big men forward.
an.foulsMany: {n} fouls by us: we risk cards and are giving away dangerous free kicks.
an.oppFoulsMany: They've committed {n} fouls: we're beating our men, keep running at them.
an.gkBusy: {name} has already made {n} saves: he's keeping us in it, there's too much space in front of him.
an.gkQuiet: Our keeper hasn't had a save to make yet: we're solid at the back.
an.starPlayer: {name} is the best player on the pitch ({v}): get the ball to him more.
an.poorPlayer: {name} is misplacing too many passes: maybe he's out of position or it's just not his day.
an.strikerQuiet: {name} hasn't had a shot yet: he's isolated, he needs someone up there with him.
an.mentalityLowTrail: We're behind but with a cautious mentality: we won't come back like this.
an.mentalityHighLead: Ahead and too open: a more balanced mentality would protect the result.
an.oppAttacking: They've come out to play (mentality {v}): there's space behind their line to attack.
an.oppDefending: They're sitting deep: we need width, patience and shots from distance to open them up.
an.famLow: The team only knows this formation {v}%: it shows in the movement, we need tactical sessions.
an.moraleLow: Squad morale at {v}: the team is playing tense, avoid risky decisions.
an.moraleHigh: High morale ({v}): the team is taking the initiative, let them play.
an.momentumUs: The momentum is ours: time to push, not to manage.
an.momentumThem: They've taken the momentum: a sub or a tactical foul breaks the rhythm.
an.opening: Opening minutes: let's see how they line up before touching anything.
an.halfTime: Half-time: the right moment to adjust pressing and width.
an.lastTen: Last ten minutes: freshness and set pieces are what count now.
an.quiet: An even game, nothing to report right now.

opp.title: Opposition tactical report
opp.advice.pressHigh: {club} press very high. Long balls to the strikers and quick switches of play to bypass their first line.
opp.advice.lineHigh: {club} play a very high defensive line: there's space in behind, look for through balls and quick forwards.
opp.advice.lowBlock: {club} sit deep. Be patient: stretch the play and push the full-backs up to open gaps.
opp.advice.wide: {club} play wide on the flanks. Tuck your full-backs in on their wingers and double up against crosses.
opp.advice.direct: {club} go forward quickly. Keep a deep line and win the second balls in midfield.
opp.advice.slow: {club} move the ball slowly. High pressing can force them into mistakes.
opp.advice.balanced: {club} have no obvious weak spots. Play to your strengths and work on set pieces.

trait.ambition.hi.name: Ambitious
trait.ambition.hi.what: Wants to play and win: the bench weighs on him more than on others and bigger clubs tempt him.
trait.ambition.lo.name: Content
trait.ambition.lo.what: Doesn't mind the bench much and rarely asks to leave.
trait.professionalism.hi.name: Professional
trait.professionalism.hi.what: Trains seriously: develops faster and declines later.
trait.professionalism.lo.name: Unprofessional
trait.professionalism.lo.what: Trains half-heartedly: develops more slowly and ages sooner.
trait.loyalty.hi.name: Loyal to the club
trait.loyalty.hi.what: Accepts a lower wage at renewal time just to stay.
trait.loyalty.lo.name: Mercenary
trait.loyalty.lo.what: No discounts at renewal time: only the wage counts.
trait.temperament.hi.name: Calm
trait.temperament.hi.what: Rarely argues, and listens when you ask him to calm down from the bench.
trait.temperament.lo.name: Fiery
trait.temperament.lo.what: Flares up easily: argues more often with team-mates and asking him to calm down does little.
trait.sociability.hi.name: Team player
trait.sociability.hi.what: Makes friends quickly and keeps the dressing room together.
trait.sociability.lo.name: Loner
trait.sociability.lo.what: Doesn't bond much with team-mates: friendships form slowly.
trait.pressureTolerance.hi.name: Handles pressure
trait.pressureTolerance.hi.what: If you needle him in a press conference or demand more from the bench, he gets fired up.
trait.pressureTolerance.lo.name: Struggles under pressure
trait.pressureTolerance.lo.what: Public criticism and shouting from the bench knock him down instead of spurring him on.

hint.desk.title: The desk
hint.desk.text: News, stories and the next match arrive here every day. The "Continue" button at the top moves the calendar on to your next fixture; "Watch the match" lets you follow it live.
hint.stories.title: Stories and press
hint.stories.text: The league tells its own stories: runs, crises, players in a purple patch. When one concerns you, journalists ask you questions: each answer shows its effect on morale and confidence first.
hint.squad.title: The squad
hint.squad.text: All your players. Click a name for the full profile: attributes, morale, contract, development. You see your own players as they really are; other clubs' players only as estimates.
hint.tactics.title: Tactics
hint.tactics.text: Choose the formation and who plays. Familiarity tells you how well the team knows the formation: changing it often has a cost. The instructions (pressing, tempo, width) really change the way you play.
hint.training.title: Training
hint.training.text: Twelve sessions a week. More load means more development but tires players and raises injury risk: the reference load is marked. Here you also choose mentors for the youngest players.
hint.dressing.title: The dressing room
hint.dressing.text: Who's friends with whom, who's in charge, who's unhappy. One player's morale spreads to the others. Promises made to players must be kept: they remember them, and so do their agents.
hint.youth.title: The academy
hint.youth.text: Every summer a new intake of youngsters arrives from the academy. Here you see how much they're playing and who's an international. You ask the board for academy facilities.
hint.market.title: The market
hint.market.text: Search for players with the filters. Other clubs' stars are estimates: the better you know them, the more accurate they are. Open a player's profile to make an offer.
hint.scouts.title: Scouts
hint.scouts.text: Send them to follow a country or a club: the more they work, the better you know the players. Careful: some always err in the same direction, optimists or pessimists by nature.
hint.finance.title: Finances
hint.finance.text: Income and costs season by season. If the wage bill goes over 72% of revenue you get a warning, a transfer embargo and then a points deduction.
hint.board.title: The board
hint.board.text: Four confidence bars and a target. You can renegotiate it: asking for time costs confidence right away, raising the bar earns some. Below a certain level at the end of the season you get sacked.
hint.live.title: The live match
hint.live.text: The 2D pitch, the bench on the left for substitutions, the analyst on the right. The "Tactical pause" lets you change mentality and instructions without stopping the season. You can skip to the next highlight or to the end.

guide.squad.text: Who the starters are, who's in form, who's unhappy.
guide.tactics.title: Choose formation and starters
guide.tactics.text: The formation that best suits the squad is already suggested: you can change it.
guide.training.title: Set up the week
guide.training.text: The balanced schedule is fine to start with.
guide.live.title: Play your first match
guide.live.text: With "Watch the match" you follow it live; with "Continue" you play it straight away.
guide.title: Your first match
guide.intro: Five steps, about ten minutes. Do them in any order you like.
guide.allDone: Done: now you know where everything is. The rest you'll discover by playing.

start.approved: Agreement approved by the board of directors
start.sign: Sign the contract and start your career
start.slotFull: All slots are in use: which one should be overwritten?
start.slotHint: The career you overwrite is lost. If you want to keep it, export it to a file first from the Saves screen.
challenge.rich: Money is no problem: the bank balance is among the richest in the league.
challenge.poor: Money is tight: every signing has to be thought through, and some sales will be needed.
challenge.midCash: The accounts are in order, but there's no room for madness.
challenge.underrated: The squad is better than the club's prestige: on paper it's the {pos|ord} best in the league. You can do better than expected.
challenge.overrated: The club's prestige promises more than the squad can deliver (on paper it's only the {pos|ord} best): there's work to do.
challenge.honest: The squad lives up to the name: on paper it's the {pos|ord} best in the league.
challenge.wages: Watch the wages: the wage bill already weighs heavily on revenue.
challenge.youth: The academy is good: something important could come through from the youth ranks.
challenge.style.youth: A club that believes in youth, and expects the same of you.
challenge.style.veterans: A club used to experienced players.
challenge.style.physical: A club that loves physical, high-energy football.
challenge.style.technical: A club that loves attractive, technical football.
challenge.style.balanced: A club without dogmas: you bring the style.
settings.title: Game and interface settings
settings.diagHint: If something goes wrong, export the diagnostics and send them to whoever is helping you: they contain versions, recent errors and the list of saves, not your career. No data is ever sent automatically.
view.highlights.hint: Only the moves that lead to goals, dangerous shots, saves, penalties, sendings-off and injuries: a match lasts 4-7 minutes
view.extended.hint: The highlights plus pressing phases and counter-attacks
view.full.hint: The whole match, move by move
live.skip: fast forward to the next highlight
overlay.shape.hint: Defensive line and centre of gravity of both teams (us blue, them red), over the last few minutes. When you change an instruction, the previous shape stays dashed.
overlay.passes.hint: Completed passes between our players in the last 10 minutes: the thicker the line, the more passes
overlay.heat.hint: Where our players have been in the last few minutes
overlay.press.hint: Where we won the ball back in the last 10 minutes (the opponents' half is on the right)

playoff.title: Play-offs and play-out
playout.title: Play-out
playout.none: No play-out: too many points between 16th and 17th, {club} go down.
playoff.name: Serie B play-offs
playout.name: Serie B play-out
tables.shadow: Serie C isn't played match by match: at the end of the season the strongest sides (with a bit of luck) take the {n} places in Serie B. If you get relegated here, Serie C is played for real.
news.playoff.in: We're in the play-offs, from {pos|ord} place.
news.playoff.through: Play-offs: through to the next round!
news.playoff.out: Play-offs: knocked out, no promotion this year.
news.playoff.won: Play-off winners: we're in Serie A!
news.playout.in: It's the play-out: two matches to stay in Serie B.
news.playout.won: Play-out won: we stay in Serie B.
news.playout.lost: Play-out lost: we're going down to Serie C.
settings.playoffsSub: From 3rd to 8th they play for the last place in Serie A; 16th and 17th play for survival if they're close. Off: the top three go up and the bottom four go down.
news.distress.1: First warning from the board: we're in the red by {pct}% of revenue. We need to sell or cut wages.
news.distress.2: Second warning: we're in the red by {pct}% of revenue. If it's over 60% at the end of the season, the club will have one year to recover.
news.distress.3: Final warning: the deficit has gone past 60% of revenue ({pct}%). If it's still like this at the end of the season, the recovery year starts; then administration.
news.distress.lastYear: The season has closed with the accounts over the limit: we have one year to get back under a 60% deficit, otherwise the club will go into administration.
news.admin.mine: The club has gone into administration: debts wiped out, {sold} of the best players sold, a {n}-point deduction next season.
news.admin.other: {club} have gone into administration: starting from scratch, with a {n}-point deduction.
